latest.title: Cómo construí un Kiosko para eventos del AWS Student Builder Group con HTML, Amplify y EmailJS
latest.description:
por Fernando Gutiérrez — AWS Student Builder Group at Instituto Tecnológico de Ocotlán 💜

En nuestro grupo AWS Student Builder Group at ITO CardenalITO's queríamos una experiencia diferente para los asistentes de nuestros eventos: que pudieran tomarse una foto, agregarle stickers con la identidad visual del programa, y recibirla por correo. trending.title: Is Node.js Still Enough? When to Move Your Backend to Rust
trending.description: Node.js remains the king of rapid development and I/O-bound tasks, but its single-threaded event loop chokes on heavy computation, while V8 garbage collection can introduce unpredictable latency spikes at scale. The answer isn't a total rewrite—it’s a hybrid architecture. Keep Node.js for your API gateway and CRUD operations, and offload CPU-heavy bottlenecks to specialized Rust microservices.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
